## 1. Objective

test: cover cancellation attribution and exit-publication ordering

CancellationToken: the fail-fast cascade completes synchronously with the
triggering failure; caller-requested cancellation is attributed separately
from timeout and fail-fast; direct cancel() is not caller attribution; the
injected domain timeout scheduler is observable; a losing transition inside
the winner's listener window does not cascade.

TaskExecutionState: skipIfPending wins only once and never releases a
claimed slot; terminal publishes before the tracker exit listener runs;
state and status mirror each lifecycle phase.

ExecutionExitTracker: awaitBounded(0) does not consume an interrupt.
